  PROBLEM: `_run_harness_hold_poller` seeds only `ai:validating` with no dispatch-cap state, so the poller never reaches `mark_validation_failed` and four new hold tests fail.
  WHY: `mark_validation_failed` is reached only via the `ai:validation-failed` or `ai:validate-failed` label (orchestrate_poll_process.sh:24482-24494) or the dispatch cap (14950-14957). Reviewers rated it BLOCKER (mapped to critical).
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:15092-15103 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: `validation_harness_marker` applies jq `capture(...)` without `try`, and `|| true` swallows the resulting error. Gemini described it only as swallowed jq errors.
  WHY: A non-matching trusted-login comment aborts the query, so the owner and route markers are never found and the hold falls back to the local fingerprint. Sonnet disputed this, saying `capture` yields no output on a non-match. Reviewers rated it MAJOR (mapped to high).
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:15115-15119 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: `validation_harness_hold_active` checks only `status==failed` and that the hold is an object, not `validation_last_raw_status == "harness_error"`. Stale-pin recovery (25133-25143) and non-harness failure branches leave a stale hold.
  WHY: A stale hold shows "Waiting for harness fix" (line 3728) and excludes the project from the unblock scan (line 23714, `reason=harness_hold`). Sonnet rated it confidence 3, the others 4. Reviewers rated it MAJOR (mapped to high).
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:15127 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: `validation_harness_hold_status_line` hardcodes `shubhodeep1/coding-workflows` instead of the consumer repository.
  WHY: Heal-issue links would point at the wrong repository for consumer repos. Sonnet and minimax disputed this, saying heal issues are filed upstream by design. Reviewers rated it MAJOR (mapped to high).
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:2488 (consumers 15115-15119, 15261-15264, 23711-23718) | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `VALIDATION_HARNESS_HOLD_MAX_DAYS` is parsed and wired but never read, so a held project has no time limit.
  WHY: With the switch default-on and no park, CRITICAL alert or unblock scan, a held project is stranded until `/revalidate`, until P2b adds the time limit. Reviewer rated it MAJOR (mapped to high).

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh (and tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py:26524-26526), `_validation_harness_hold_finish` ~15137-15139 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The hold helper's `set_tracking_phase_label "ai:validation-failed"` is not followed by `needs_human_park_project`, so the guard test fails.
  WHY: CI job orchestrate-poll (1) fails with `FAIL test_needs_human_digest_terminal_paths_call_the_helper: 15137`. The guard test should exempt the hold helper.
- tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py `_run_harness_hold_poller` (~15298-15315) and `test_validation_harness_hold_caps_keep_today_park_path` | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Fixtures seed `ai:validating` with no `validation_last_dispatch_ts` or dispatch count, so the poller re-dispatches instead of reaching `mark_validation_failed`.
  WHY: Four new hold tests never enter the code they assert on and fail in CI. The fix is to seed `validation_last_dispatch_ts=1` and `validation_cycle_dispatch_count=3`, or the failure label.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh `validation_harness_hold_active` 15115-15119, stale-pin recovery 25133-25143 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The predicate checks only `status == failed` and that the hold is an object. Stale-pin recovery and the non-harness `mark_validation_failed` branches leave the hold in state.
  WHY: A later non-harness failure is mislabeled "Waiting for harness fix" (line 3728) and skipped by the unblock scan (line 23714). The fix is to require `.validation_last_raw_status == "harness_error"` and delete the hold in stale-pin recovery.
- Dropped as unfounded: the `capture` error claim (jq yields no output on a non-match) and the hardcoded repository slug (consistent with the plan).
- HARDENING: `validation_harness_hold_active` line 15118, add `and (.validation_last_raw_status == "harness_error")` (1 line). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:15138 (`_validation_harness_hold_finish`, followed on 15139 by `gh_retry gh issue edit ...`) | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The hold helper is the only `ai:validation-failed` site that is intentionally not parked, and the guard test at tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py:26524-26526 was not exempted.
  WHY: The guard asserts at index 15137 and fails `orchestrate-poll (0)`. The fix is a test exemption, not adding the park call, which would break the `== 3` count assertion at line 26522.
- tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py:15310 (`_run_harness_hold_poller`, `tracking_labels=["ai:validating"]`) | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `mark_validation_failed` is reached only with the `ai:validation-failed` or `ai:validate-failed` label (orchestrate_poll_process.sh:24482) or the cap path at 14954-14957. The fixture falls through to `dispatch_validation_if_needed` (24527).
  WHY: Four new tests fail on the head. The fix is to seed `tracking_labels=["ai:validation-failed"]`.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:15092 and 15095 (`validation_harness_marker`) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: jq `capture/1` raises an error on a non-match and aborts the program, and `2>/dev/null || true` swallows it. The repo idiom is `try (... capture(...)) catch null` (25569).
  WHY: `harness_hold_owner` is always empty on a real tracking issue, so the hold falls back to `local:<16hex>`.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:15118 (`validation_harness_hold_active`) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The predicate is not tied to the failure class. Stale-pin recovery (25133-25142) and the deterministic-class (15300-15308) and recovery-exhausted branches leave the hold.
  WHY: A stale hold renders "Waiting for harness fix" at line 3728 and drops the project from the unblock judge at line 23714. The fix is to add `.validation_last_raw_status == "harness_error"`.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:2488 (consumers 15115-15119, 15261-15264, 23711-23718) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `VALIDATION_HARNESS_HOLD_MAX_DAYS` is parsed and wired but never read.
  WHY: Held projects get one Telegram WARNING and then sit in `failed` indefinitely until P2b. The fix is to treat the hold as inactive after the max age, or ship the switch default-off.
- HARDENING: `_validation_harness_hold_finish` 15156-15158, `update_completion_status_comment … || true` can leave the hold unposted when the update fails. Fix: set `COMPLETION_STATUS_STATE_CHANGED=true` on a non-zero return (1 line). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3
- Dropped: the hardcoded `shubhodeep1/coding-workflows` link (the heal issue is filed upstream and `heal_issue` is null in this phase) and Gemini's attribution of the test failures to `ORCHESTRATOR_ENGINE_SHA`.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
